applicability.legacy: v1beta1 is not served in the pinned CRDs. Exact installed discovery, verbs, schema, controller installation and provider capability govern use; schema alone is not permission.
applicability.refresh: Primary CRD directory, ExternalSecret, AWS auth, ClusterExternalSecret and PushSecret Go APIs refreshed during implementation. clusterpushsecret_types.go does not exist; ClusterPushSecret shares pushsecret_types.go.

shared.identity: Host owns metadata.name/namespace and edit locks; cluster targets omit namespace.
shared.canonical: Revision/session atomic scalar patches and array insert/remove operations. Never serialize projected containers. Unknown fields, scalar types, exact integers and comments belong to canonical host.
shared.privacy: No credential fetch or plaintext preview. Mask template data/metadata, wildcard literal/Secret templates, provider metadata, externalID, status and generated annotations. No status/provider messages rendered.
shared.ownership: declarative policy is not authorization; controller/system evidence or controller ownerReferences forces inspection. No status/annotation mutations or false refresh success.
shared.controls: Actual base-ui Button and shared EditorField/ExactValueField/EditorChoice/ReferencePicker/KeyValueFields/EditorSection. Help uses shared accessible help. Partial invalid integers/durations remain local.
shared.source: Host Form/YAML preference and AST only; no localStorage, second draft, source parser or registry.

ExternalSecret.Store scope/name: spec.secretStoreRef.kind/name; actual namespaced or cluster GVR metadata lookup
ExternalSecret.Key mappings add/remove: spec.data[i].secretKey, remoteRef.key/property; scalar leaf changes preserve sourceRef, version and decoding/conversion siblings
ExternalSecret.Template references: spec.target.template.templateFrom[i].configMap.name/items[j].key; nested repeatable rows with metadata-only ConfigMap lookup
ExternalSecret.Source retained: dataFrom, sourceRef, remoteRef.version/conversion/decoding/metadata policies, target.immutable, template type/engine/merge/payloads; no destructive conversion

SecretStore.Authentication choice: spec.provider.aws.auth.jwt or secretRef; explicit branch change atomically removes only prior auth branch; controller identity removes branches
SecretStore.Secret references: spec.provider.aws.auth.secretRef.accessKeyIDSecretRef/secretAccessKeySecretRef/sessionTokenSecretRef name/key; metadata-only Secret lookup never credential bodies
SecretStore.Provider boundary: AWS guided; any different provider retains honest YAML/provider fallback; no implicit provider replacement
SecretStore.Source retained: AWS role chains, session tags, externalID, additional roles, provider settings and unknown fields

ClusterSecretStore.Connection: Same AWS fields as SecretStore; explicit reference namespace for JWT and credential selectors
ClusterSecretStore.Allowed namespaces: spec.conditions[i].namespaces[j] repeatable condition/name rows; omitted conditions visibly allow all namespaces
ClusterSecretStore.Source retained: namespaceSelector, namespaceRegexes and unknown conditions remain untouched

ClusterExternalSecret.Fan-out: spec.externalSecretName, spec.refreshTime, spec.namespaceSelectors[i].matchLabels[k]; repeatable selectors and key/value controls
ClusterExternalSecret.Consequence: Future namespaces can match; child Secrets may be created; parent interval distinct from child interval

PushSecret.Source: spec.selector.secret.name; same-namespace metadata-only Secret lookup; generator/label-selector variants retained without changing union
PushSecret.Destinations: spec.secretStoreRefs[i].kind/name repeatable exact store references; labelSelector variants retain source boundary
PushSecret.Mappings: spec.data[i].match.secretKey/remoteRef.remoteKey/property; blank secretKey means whole Secret; add/remove arrays without copying siblings
PushSecret.Policies: spec.refreshInterval, updatePolicy Replace|IfNotExists, deletionPolicy None|Delete; visible overwrite/delete external-system consequences
PushSecret.Source retained: selector generatorRef/label selectors, provider metadata, conversionStrategy, payload templates

ClusterPushSecret.Consequence: Each current/future selected namespace may write external systems

mapping.Generated ExternalSecret: Controller-owner inspection; owner kind/name only, no source/status/provider message rendering or child mutations; parent navigation requires shared host integration
mapping.Generated PushSecret: Same controller-owner inspection boundary, no external write/refresh execution or ordinary child Create/Edit

regressions: ExternalSecretsEditor.test.tsx: scalar mapping preservation; local partial integer retention; controller ownership/privacy; cluster auth namespace/conflict validation; generator source and nested fan-out validation
verification: Not run by worker; parent runs integrated checks and canonical screenshot wave.
